storyScope.centralIncident: Officer investigates a hit-and-run pedestrian crash and interrogates an overly calm pedestrian whose elaborate alibi collapses under physical evidence.
storyScope.centralViewerQuestion: Can the calm suspect talk his way out of a felony hit-and-run before physical evidence traps him?
storyScope.primaryConflict: Suspect spinning multiple contradictory alibis while officer methodically uncovers blood, glass, and car keys on his person.
storyScope.initialState: Officer responds to pedestrian hit-and-run scene and searches nearby streets.
storyScope.targetEndState: Suspect's alibi is demolished by car key fob panic test; handcuffed for felony hit-and-run.
storyScope.mainOpenLoop: Why does this calm pedestrian have broken safety glass embedded in his knuckles?

centralViewerQuestion: Can the calm suspect talk his way out of a felony hit-and-run before physical evidence traps him?
hookPromise: Calculated pedestrian alibi completely unravels when an officer tests the key fob in his jacket pocket.

beats.newInformation: Suspect chuckles casually: 'Officer, I have been walking my dog for an hour, I do not even own a vehicle.'
beats.viewerQuestionBefore: Is this man innocent or lying?

beats.newInformation: Officer points beam at suspect boots, covered in broken windshield safety glass; CUT before rewind!
beats.viewerStateAfter: Shocked by smoking-gun physical evidence contradiction.
beats.whyThisBeatNow: Teaser partial reveal cuts before full explanation.

beats.newInformation: Officer arrives at pedestrian collision site: victim thrown 30 feet, car fled scene leaving white paint chips.
Dispatch advises: Fleeing car is a white sedan with severe passenger windshield fracture.
beats.whyThisBeatNow: Connects crime scene to vehicle characteristics without repeating teaser.

beats.newInformation: Officer locates suspect walking alone on dark sidewalk two blocks from collision site with no dog in sight.
beats.viewerStateAfter: Suspect intercepted; note absence of animal.

beats.newInformation: Suspect presents his rehearsed alibi: 'Good evening officer, just walking my terrier, beautiful night isn't it?'
Officer asks where the terrier is; suspect stumbles: 'Oh, she slipped her collar and ran into the woods back there.'
Flashlight illuminates suspect hands: fresh, bleeding lacerations across knuckles filled with micro-glass particles.
beats.viewerStateAfter: Physical injury linked directly to broken glass.

beats.newInformation: Officer challenges directly: 'Those are safety glass cuts on your knuckles, and your jacket smells like burnt radiator coolant.'
Suspect shifts story: 'Look, I was in the passenger seat, my friend Dave was driving and he took off on foot!'
beats.viewerStateAfter: Story completely shifts from dog walker to passenger.
beats.whyThisBeatNow: Secondary alibi confirms original story was a total lie.

beats.newInformation: Officer spots a car key fob hanging out of suspect right jacket pocket with a white sedan keychain.
beats.viewerStateAfter: Spotting key fob; deciding test imminent.

beats.newInformation: Officer presses red panic button on fob; loud alarm horn blares from a white sedan hidden 40 yards away in a driveway!
beats.viewerStateAfter: Irrefutable proof; suspect's deception completely destroyed.
beats.whyThisBeatNow: Cinematic climax of the contradiction ladder.

beats.newInformation: Officer orders suspect to turn around and applies double-locking handcuffs for felony hit-and-run.
Dispatch radios urgent update: 'Vehicle registration returns to County Commissioner Arthur Cole, who is currently out on felony bail!'
beats.viewerStateAfter: High-ranking public official identity revealed, multiplying scandal and stakes.
beats.cliffhangerQuestion: Will County Commissioner Cole face revoked bail and mandatory prison time in Part 2?
beats.cliffhangerNewInformation: Suspect is a high-profile county official out on active felony bail.
beats.cliffhangerSpecificFact: Vehicle registration matches County Commissioner Arthur Cole out on active felony bail.
beats.cliffhangerExpectedNextPayoff: Part 2 reveals police interview and bail revocation hearing.
